checks.name: handler is registered in native report handler registry
POST delegates intact wizard action and merges user/action context preserving active ids
authenticated transport supplies CSRF token same-origin no-store and bounded abort signal
missing optional action context or CSRF does not drop user context
valid PDF with absent or malformed disposition uses action filename
PDF MIME alone cannot authorize a non-PDF signature
PDF signature with wrong MIME is rejected without a preview blob
HTTP errors preserve parsed native report exception
unstructured server/login failure becomes a preparation error and clears timeout
network rejection propagates an error and always clears timeout
response body failure also clears timeout
timeout abort yields actionable error and removes its timer
synchronous URL preparation failure cannot leak timeout before fetch
non-PDF and explicit bypass use native fallback without status check or fetch
wkhtmltopdf missing/broken/upgrade status returns native fallback before fetch
wkhtmltopdf probe rejection cannot produce false native fallback or report fetch
preparation failure unblocks UI and rejects without dialog or duplicate fallback
handler fetches once unblocks before dialog and remains pending until dialog closes
dialog add failure rejects after UI is unblocked
Print readiness is gated in template and load auto-prints only once
Print exceptions show browser-help fallback without fetching another report
Download is available before readiness and reuses exact prepared Blob/filename
dialog destroy clears frame source and revokes only its owned Blob URL
HTTP 502 maps to native ConnectionLostError without decoding response body
trailing disposition separator is removed before native filename parser
PDF MIME parameters do not reject a valid signature
context serialization error before fetch still clears its timeout
handler timeout rejects and unblocks with no preview dialog
complete dialog lifecycle reuses one fetched blob for Print and Download until close
native no-load switches after five seconds to bundled viewer with exact same encoded blob
known unsupported native PDF viewer switches immediately without five-second timer
native readiness cancels automatic fallback and explicit alternative remains available
alternative frame no-load timeout shows help and destroy clears both timers
compatible readiness awaits initializedPromise before pages and Print
documentloaded alone stays unready until pageViewsReady and pagesPromise complete
missing pdfDocument cannot authorize compatible Print
page readiness polling is bounded to 120 attempts at 250ms with help afterwards
destroy while awaiting initialization prevents delayed readiness or timers
destroy while awaiting pages makes continuation inert and clears frame source
late scheduled poll after destruction cannot reschedule or print
missing or rejected viewer initialization remains unready with download available
rejected pages promise shows help without automatic printing
Print guard enforces readiness and rechecks compatible page views at click time
repeated compatible load events cannot auto-print twice after shared page promise
repeated compatible load events cannot orphan polling timer after destroy
